neighborhoods: Forest Hill, Rosedale, Lawrence Park, Hoggs Hollow, The Annex, Leaside, Bridle Path, Yorkville, Cabbagetown, Wellesley, Chaplin Crescent
intro: Toronto is our backyard, and we've spent over three decades lighting some of the city's most distinguished homes. From the historic mansions of Rosedale and Forest Hill to the contemporary builds in Lawrence Park, our designers know how to compliment every architectural style.
extra: We're the team behind the displays you've stopped to photograph on Wellesley, Chaplin Crescent, and Neville in the Beaches. Award-winning, fully insured, and built for Toronto's unique mix of mature trees, intricate rooflines, and tight urban lots.

neighborhoods: Woodbridge, Maple, Kleinburg, Thornhill, Vellore Village, Sonoma Heights, Patterson, Concord
intro: Vaughan is home base for our team. We've lit thousands of homes across Woodbridge, Maple, Kleinburg, and the newer Vellore communities. Our crew lives here — we know the streets, the architectural styles, and the expectations.
extra: Vaughan homes tend to feature large rooflines, dramatic entrances, and significant landscape features. We design displays that scale appropriately, lighting the entire property — not just the eaves — for a complete, magazine-worthy look.

neighborhoods: Unionville, Cornell, Cathedraltown, Berczy Village, Cachet, Buttonville, Markham Village, Thornhill
intro: Markham residents demand quality, and we deliver. From the heritage homes of Unionville to the executive estates in Cachet, our award-winning designs add elegance without overstatement.
extra: We handle the entire process — design, install, maintenance, takedown, storage. Most Markham clients come back year after year. Subsequent years cost 45–55% less because you already own the lights.

neighborhoods: Bayview Hill, Mill Pond, Oak Ridges, Jefferson, South Richvale, Doncrest, Westbrook

neighborhoods: Lorne Park, Mineola, Port Credit, Streetsville, Erin Mills, Meadowvale, Clarkson, Lakeview, Credit Mills

neighborhoods: Old Oakville, Glen Abbey, Bronte, Glenorchy, Joshua Creek, Iroquois Ridge, Falgarwood, River Oaks
